Write a Python function `longest_common_prefix(strs)` where strs is a list of strings; return the longest common prefix string among them (empty string if the list is empty or there is no common prefix).

Reply with a single Python code block containing only your function definition(s) (imports allowed if needed). Do not include any example usage, test calls, or print statements of your own -- a separate test harness will be run against your function afterward. Do not print anything else outside the code block.
